title: BlockBrawl community mode manifest (mode.json)
description: Describes one community mode: identity, player counts, timing, files and its store listing. `brawl-modes check` enforces the same rules (devkit/build.js validateManifest), and the server enforces them again.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor support. Ignored by the kit and the server.

id.description: Unique mode id: 3-32 chars, lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter. Must equal the folder name. Never change it after the first release.

version.description: Semver. Bump it for every change you submit: the server approves one exact build per id@version.

sdk.description: The SDK line the mode is written against. This kit runs SDK 0.1.

author.description: Who made it, as shown in the store.

runtime.description: online: server rules, multiplayer, verified results. offline: client only, no server, nothing verified (see docs/offline-modes.md).

tagline.description: One line for the store card.

tags.description: Store filters: up to 8 tags, 2-20 chars each, lowercase letters, digits, dashes.

players.description: How many players a match has: 1 <= min <= max <= 8. Offline modes use 1 and 1.

orientation.description: The screen orientation the client is designed for.

server.description: Online only: the server entry file, usually server.js.

client.description: The client HTML document, usually client/index.html.

clientModel.description: Online only: the client model module (no DOM), usually client/model.js.

fuzz.description: Online only: the module exporting nextAction(model, playerId, rng), used by test and bench.
